'''Zakuul lurkers''', also known as '''Swamp lurkers''', were a subspecies of [[Lurker/Legends|lurkers]], [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibian]] bipeds mysteriously spread throughout the [[The galaxy/Legends|Galaxy]].<ref name="codex" /> Zakuul lurkers were found primarily in the [[Endless Swamp]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zakuul]].<ref name="zakuul">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=location|[[Endless Swamp]]|[[Zakuul]]}}</ref>

Distinctively from other lurkers and commonly among the fauna of [[Zakuul]], lurkers of the [[Endless Swamp]] had grey skin with gold coloring on the back side of the body. They also had a dappled pattern on their belly and red claws.<ref name="zakuul lurker" />
